title: Prohibition of business at unauthorized locations.
bodyText:
PART V. PLACES OF BUSINESS

Except as expressly authorized by this chapter or by federal law, no financial institution shall conduct any business in this State except at places of business or in the manner authorized in this part and except to the extent so authorized.
bodyHtml:
PART V.  PLACES OF BUSINESS

 

     §412:3-500  Prohibition of business at unauthorized locations.  Except as expressly authorized by this chapter or by federal law, no financial institution shall conduct any business in this State except at places of business or in the manner authorized in this part and except to the extent so authorized. [L 1993, c 350, pt of §1]

  Automated teller machine fees, see §412:14-100.
